notablePrerequisites:
You have a storm count of at least five.
Your life total is at least seven.
description:
Activate Treasonous Ogre twice by paying 6 life, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir's ability infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
